question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**tiny**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests that the blank should be filled with a word that indicates something very small in size.
 
• The word "tiny" (छोटा) perfectly fits this context as it means very small.
 
• "**Cute**" and "**minor**" do not convey the idea of small size as effectively as "**tiny**" does.
 
• "**Minute**" also means very small but "**tiny**" is more commonly used in everyday language, making it the most appropriate choice here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Cute (प्यारा): **"Cute" refers to something attractive or endearing.
 
• **Minor (अल्प):** "Minor" means something of lesser importance or seriousness.
 
• **Minute (सूक्ष्म):** "Minute" also means very small, but "tiny" is more commonly used in everyday language.
